nodes.description: Public token name string set in the base constructor.
Public token symbol string set in the base constructor.
uint8 decimals defaulting to 18, used to scale the initial supply.
Total token supply, minted to the deployer in the constructor.
Mapping of address to token balance, mutated by both _transfer implementations.
Base constructor that mints the whole supply to msg.sender and assigns name/symbol.
Internal base transfer that checks balances, subtracts from sender, adds to recipient and asserts the balance invariant.
Public transfer that forwards msg.sender, _to and _value to the internal _transfer.
Derived constructor that simply forwards its arguments to the base constructor.
Overriding internal _transfer in EROSTOKEN that mutates balances without the previousBalances assertion.
Caller-controlled address used for minting the initial supply and as the default transfer sender.
totalSupply = initialSupply * 10 ** uint256(decimals); unchecked multiplication that can overflow.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value in ContractTokenERC20._transfer, a balance decrement.
balanceOf[_to] += _value in ContractTokenERC20._transfer, a balance increment.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value in EROSTOKEN._transfer, a balance decrement.
balanceOf[_to] += _value in EROSTOKEN._transfer, a balance increment.
balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply in the base constructor, privilege-bearing initial allocation.
